text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Now then, this month's special will cover the Senior Spring Double Crown—the spring Tenno Sho and Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: With one being 3,200 meters and the other 2,200, they obviously call for different strategies, which I hope to learn more about through interviews…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: What's different between the spring Tenno Sho and the Takarazuka Kinen? What do you think, Inari One?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Don't be a goof! There is no difference! At the end of the day, both races are…

text_block_list.name: Inari & Kitasan
text_block_list.text: A spring festival!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I mean, what else could they be?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Right?! All that matters is winning and making the crowd go wild!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho and Takarazuka Kinen… Well, from my perspective, they are the same.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Regardless of the distance, my winning equation will bring me to victory.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I couldn't agree more.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: No matter the distance, it is I who takes the turf! I who emerges triumphant! I who suffers defeat! I am the common denominator!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The season of spring speaks to my character. Of course that goes for summer, fall, and winter too! Haaah ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: …I'm quite surprised to see that our opinions align.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: (I couldn't find a runner who saw a difference. Is winning both races only possible by not worrying about things as major as distance?)

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: (There must be someone who sees them differently…)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: They're different if ya ask me. Completely different. The difference is clear as day.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: (Finally! I knew there'd be someone who sees the difference!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen's at Hanshin, which is basically Osaka! And the spring Tenno Sho's in Kyoto! They're nothing alike!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: First of all, the food's way too expensive in Kyoto. I can't afford to eat anything over there!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Basically, the Takarazuka Kinen's home, and the spring Tenno Sho's away! Got it?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I've made a wonderful discovery! The two races differ not just in length, but also in their image and culture as well!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I must dig deeper into this perspective…

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Time for a food trip around Kyoto and Osaka!
